result.summary: The layout is functional and consistent, though it relies on generic vector illustrations rather than real merchant photography, giving it a placeholder-like appearance.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used instead of actual restaurant food photos, which makes the app appear unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Implement actual merchant imagery to improve visual appeal and user trust.

issues.description: Inconsistent placement of delivery time information between different sections (on-image badges vs. text metadata).
issues.suggestion: Standardize the information architecture to ensure delivery times appear in the same relative location for all cards.
